What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V)]]: left, the image of [[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V) (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit 53572eb); right, the image of [[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon (V) (Errata 3)]] (holotable commit 4c681fe). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/53572eb94d14c4f21f0f3396874727653397c6e8/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/hanchewieandthefalcon.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/4c681fe16e36ecdacae201ebbf106b07ffea132b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/hanchewieandthefalcon.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
